registre_de_la_chambre: Registre de la Chambre des Comtes de Rousset-Lavandieres, Vendomois, France
histoire_de_la_piece: Acquired in 1850 by Madame Émilie de Brune, wife of Comte Léon de Brune, through a marriage alliance with the Vicomtesse Henriette de la Roche. Passed down to her daughter, Madame Colette de la Roche, who bequeathed it to her son-in-law, Monsieur Thibault Dumont, in 1885. Since then, it has been owned by the family of Evelyn Dumont.
